meta.title: Oath of Purity
meta.description: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: The Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon
units.displayText: The Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon

spans.text: The Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon

units.rawText: Angelus, what are you doing?!
units.displayText: Angelus, what are you doing?!

spans.text: Angelus, what are you doing?!

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier does not immediately reply. She gestures at the air, recycling the arrows she fired previously into operands.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier does not immediately reply. She gestures at the air, recycling the arrows she fired previously into operands.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier does not immediately reply. She gestures at the air, recycling the arrows she fired previously into operands.

units.rawText: I will make for the frontline to assist Lord Hesperus.
units.displayText: I will make for the frontline to assist Lord Hesperus.

spans.text: I will make for the frontline to assist Lord Hesperus.

units.rawText: Before that, I shall safely escort you away.
units.displayText: Before that, I shall safely escort you away.

spans.text: Before that, I shall safely escort you away.

units.rawText: These are not Hesperus' orders, are they?
units.displayText: These are not Hesperus' orders, are they?

spans.text: These are not Hesperus' orders, are they?

units.rawText: Angelus hesitates for a moment, revealing the truth after thinking over her words.
units.displayText: Angelus hesitates for a moment, revealing the truth after thinking over her words.

spans.text: Angelus hesitates for a moment, revealing the truth after thinking over her words.

units.rawText: I received a message from Lord Hesperus, instructing me to escort you as you retreat and commanding me to stay away from the frontline.
units.displayText: I received a message from Lord Hesperus, instructing me to escort you as you retreat and commanding me to stay away from the frontline.

spans.text: I received a message from Lord Hesperus, instructing me to escort you as you retreat and commanding me to stay away from the frontline.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus did not respond to further requests for communication... I know what that means.
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus did not respond to further requests for communication... I know what that means.

spans.text: Lord Hesperus did not respond to further requests for communication... I know what that means.

units.rawText: Hearing this, the duo's faces become conflicted much like Angelus'. Antonina moves to say something, but is interrupted immediately by Angelus.
units.displayText: Hearing this, the duo's faces become conflicted much like Angelus'. Antonina moves to say something, but is interrupted immediately by Angelus.

spans.text: Hearing this, the duo's faces become conflicted much like Angelus'. Antonina moves to say something, but is interrupted immediately by Angelus.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus still fights! There is still time, I...
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus still fights! There is still time, I...

spans.text: Lord Hesperus still fights! There is still time, I...

units.rawText: Before Angelus can finish, dazzling flames suddenly apply a shade of red to the shattered exterior of the Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: Before Angelus can finish, dazzling flames suddenly apply a shade of red to the shattered exterior of the Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: Before Angelus can finish, dazzling flames suddenly apply a shade of red to the shattered exterior of the Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: Angelus looks towards the section of the battlefield Eosphorus is responsible for. An unending wall of flame sprouts from the wall, sheltering the remaining Sanctifiers behind it, leaving him to partake in the carnage alone.
units.displayText: Angelus looks towards the section of the battlefield Eosphorus is responsible for. An unending wall of flame sprouts from the wall, sheltering the remaining Sanctifiers behind it, leaving him to partake in the carnage alone.

spans.text: Angelus looks towards the section of the battlefield Eosphorus is responsible for. An unending wall of flame sprouts from the wall, sheltering the remaining Sanctifiers behind it, leaving him to partake in the carnage alone.

units.rawText: The flames burn away and slay the Entropics in droves, but there are always more to pounce on this faint light.
units.displayText: The flames burn away and slay the Entropics in droves, but there are always more to pounce on this faint light.

spans.text: The flames burn away and slay the Entropics in droves, but there are always more to pounce on this faint light.

units.rawText: ...Damn it!
units.displayText: ...Damn it!

spans.text: ...Damn it!

units.rawText: She attempts to unfurl her wings and take flight, but her feathered wings are far too damaged from the previous battle and she fails to get off the ground.
units.displayText: She attempts to unfurl her wings and take flight, but her feathered wings are far too damaged from the previous battle and she fails to get off the ground.

spans.text: She attempts to unfurl her wings and take flight, but her feathered wings are far too damaged from the previous battle and she fails to get off the ground.

units.rawText: ...There's no time.
units.displayText: ...There's no time.

spans.text: ...There's no time.

units.rawText: Antonina, how is the Reverse Babylon Tower?
units.displayText: Antonina, how is the Reverse Babylon Tower?

spans.text: Antonina, how is the Reverse Babylon Tower?

units.rawText: The Entropization progress has come under control, but many Entropics are still active.
units.displayText: The Entropization progress has come under control, but many Entropics are still active.

spans.text: The Entropization progress has come under control, but many Entropics are still active.

units.rawText: And the outer walls?
units.displayText: And the outer walls?

spans.text: And the outer walls?

units.rawText: No traces of the Entropics, relatively safe... Wait, what are you planning?
units.displayText: No traces of the Entropics, relatively safe... Wait, what are you planning?

spans.text: No traces of the Entropics, relatively safe... Wait, what are you planning?

units.rawText: That's good... Apologies, I have some things I must verify myself. I will be back in a moment.
units.displayText: That's good... Apologies, I have some things I must verify myself. I will be back in a moment.

spans.text: That's good... Apologies, I have some things I must verify myself. I will be back in a moment.

units.rawText: Angelus forms an arrow with her remaining operands, leaping towards the outside world.
units.displayText: Angelus forms an arrow with her remaining operands, leaping towards the outside world.

spans.text: Angelus forms an arrow with her remaining operands, leaping towards the outside world.

units.rawText: Angelus!
units.displayText: Angelus!

spans.text: Angelus!

units.rawText: Ignoring the force of the wind in freefall, the Greater Sanctifier fires a curved shot, attempting to reinforce Hesperus from where the wall of fire does not cover.
units.displayText: Ignoring the force of the wind in freefall, the Greater Sanctifier fires a curved shot, attempting to reinforce Hesperus from where the wall of fire does not cover.

spans.text: Ignoring the force of the wind in freefall, the Greater Sanctifier fires a curved shot, attempting to reinforce Hesperus from where the wall of fire does not cover.

units.rawText: Yet the result is as she expected. The rain of arrows is thoroughly stopped while still airborne, with no chance to get around the wall.
units.displayText: Yet the result is as she expected. The rain of arrows is thoroughly stopped while still airborne, with no chance to get around the wall.

spans.text: Yet the result is as she expected. The rain of arrows is thoroughly stopped while still airborne, with no chance to get around the wall.

units.rawText: Complete, thorough obstruction. Lord Hesperus, you...
units.displayText: Complete, thorough obstruction. Lord Hesperus, you...

spans.text: Complete, thorough obstruction. Lord Hesperus, you...

units.rawText: The rapidly approaching terra firma leaves no time for her to think.
units.displayText: The rapidly approaching terra firma leaves no time for her to think.

spans.text: The rapidly approaching terra firma leaves no time for her to think.

units.rawText: Angelus can only plunge arrow after arrow of operand into the outer wall, trying to slow her descent.
units.displayText: Angelus can only plunge arrow after arrow of operand into the outer wall, trying to slow her descent.

spans.text: Angelus can only plunge arrow after arrow of operand into the outer wall, trying to slow her descent.

units.rawText: But with her hampered neural cloud, her arrows shatter one after the other, finding no purchase.
units.displayText: But with her hampered neural cloud, her arrows shatter one after the other, finding no purchase.

spans.text: But with her hampered neural cloud, her arrows shatter one after the other, finding no purchase.

units.rawText: ...Tch!
units.displayText: ...Tch!

spans.text: ...Tch!

units.rawText: Over here, Angelus!
units.displayText: Over here, Angelus!

spans.text: Over here, Angelus!

units.rawText: A mobile platform bearing the two approach Angelus from above.
units.displayText: A mobile platform bearing the two approach Angelus from above.

spans.text: A mobile platform bearing the two approach Angelus from above.

units.rawText: She does not hesitate to grab onto the platform's railings, shooting an explosive arrow with the centrifugal force.
units.displayText: She does not hesitate to grab onto the platform's railings, shooting an explosive arrow with the centrifugal force.

spans.text: She does not hesitate to grab onto the platform's railings, shooting an explosive arrow with the centrifugal force.

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: Three sequential explosions barely stop the platform in midair.
units.displayText: Three sequential explosions barely stop the platform in midair.

spans.text: Three sequential explosions barely stop the platform in midair.

units.rawText: That was close... nearly turned into mincemeat patty.
units.displayText: That was close... nearly turned into mincemeat patty.

spans.text: That was close... nearly turned into mincemeat patty.

units.rawText: Still apprehensive, the Doll turns around, trying to persuade her impulsive comrade.
units.displayText: Still apprehensive, the Doll turns around, trying to persuade her impulsive comrade.

spans.text: Still apprehensive, the Doll turns around, trying to persuade her impulsive comrade.

units.rawText: I understand how you feel, Angelus, but facing down the Entropics in this state is just too dangerous!
units.displayText: I understand how you feel, Angelus, but facing down the Entropics in this state is just too dangerous!

spans.text: I understand how you feel, Angelus, but facing down the Entropics in this state is just too dangerous!

units.rawText: ...It matters not how dangerous it is. If Lord Hesperus falls here, then...!
units.displayText: ...It matters not how dangerous it is. If Lord Hesperus falls here, then...!

spans.text: ...It matters not how dangerous it is. If Lord Hesperus falls here, then...!

units.rawText: She stops herself. Beyond that boundary lies a future she has yet to and would much rather not consider.
units.displayText: She stops herself. Beyond that boundary lies a future she has yet to and would much rather not consider.

spans.text: She stops herself. Beyond that boundary lies a future she has yet to and would much rather not consider.

units.rawText: Sigh... Perhaps you do need a face-to-face explanation and farewell.
units.displayText: Sigh... Perhaps you do need a face-to-face explanation and farewell.

spans.text: Sigh... Perhaps you do need a face-to-face explanation and farewell.

units.rawText: The surroundings suddenly freeze. The scenery nearby changes after a mere blink.
units.displayText: The surroundings suddenly freeze. The scenery nearby changes after a mere blink.

spans.text: The surroundings suddenly freeze. The scenery nearby changes after a mere blink.

units.rawText: The broken and shattered Reverse Babylon Tower was no more. A divine, flawless space of pure white takes its place.
units.displayText: The broken and shattered Reverse Babylon Tower was no more. A divine, flawless space of pure white takes its place.

spans.text: The broken and shattered Reverse Babylon Tower was no more. A divine, flawless space of pure white takes its place.

units.rawText: ...This is... my Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: ...This is... my Sacred Canon.

spans.text: ...This is... my Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: Yes, this would be my second time visiting.
units.displayText: Yes, this would be my second time visiting.

spans.text: Yes, this would be my second time visiting.

units.rawText: A familiar voice appears behind her. Angelus turns around, confirming her own conjecture.
units.displayText: A familiar voice appears behind her. Angelus turns around, confirming her own conjecture.

spans.text: A familiar voice appears behind her. Angelus turns around, confirming her own conjecture.

units.rawText: Sorry, Professor, we have no time to talk.
units.displayText: Sorry, Professor, we have no time to talk.

spans.text: Sorry, Professor, we have no time to talk.

units.rawText: The frontline's state is worse than you could ever imagine. Eosphorus first Entropized the Sacred Canon, then summoned an Entropic horde. Sanctifier losses have been heavy and we are depending on Lord Hesperus' forceful division of the battlefield to delay the enemies...
units.displayText: The frontline's state is worse than you could ever imagine. Eosphorus first Entropized the Sacred Canon, then summoned an Entropic horde. Sanctifier losses have been heavy and we are depending on Lord Hesperus' forceful division of the battlefield to delay the enemies...

spans.text: The frontline's state is worse than you could ever imagine. Eosphorus first Entropized the Sacred Canon, then summoned an Entropic horde. Sanctifier losses have been heavy and we are depending on Lord Hesperus' forceful division of the battlefield to delay the enemies...

units.rawText: I have no power to interfere on the battlefield currently. I must think of some other way to assist Lord Hesperus!
units.displayText: I have no power to interfere on the battlefield currently. I must think of some other way to assist Lord Hesperus!

spans.text: I have no power to interfere on the battlefield currently. I must think of some other way to assist Lord Hesperus!

units.rawText: No need, Angelus.
units.displayText: No need, Angelus.

spans.text: No need, Angelus.

units.rawText: As agreed, I would handle everything on the frontline. You need only handle your delegated duties.
units.displayText: As agreed, I would handle everything on the frontline. You need only handle your delegated duties.

spans.text: As agreed, I would handle everything on the frontline. You need only handle your delegated duties.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier leader's figure emerges from the darkness, approaching the two.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader's figure emerges from the darkness, approaching the two.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader's figure emerges from the darkness, approaching the two.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus...
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus...

spans.text: Lord Hesperus...

units.rawText: I asked the Oasis' Professor to connect to your Sacred Canon and create this space using their neural cloud.
units.displayText: I asked the Oasis' Professor to connect to your Sacred Canon and create this space using their neural cloud.

spans.text: I asked the Oasis' Professor to connect to your Sacred Canon and create this space using their neural cloud.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' understanding of us is too deep and he watched closely over my movements. I had no option but to make a request of the Professor... I apologize. I did not intend to add further difficulties to your operation.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' understanding of us is too deep and he watched closely over my movements. I had no option but to make a request of the Professor... I apologize. I did not intend to add further difficulties to your operation.

spans.text: Eosphorus' understanding of us is too deep and he watched closely over my movements. I had no option but to make a request of the Professor... I apologize. I did not intend to add further difficulties to your operation.

units.rawText: Don't worry. Time does not pass here like the outside world and there's no need to worry about the mission.
units.displayText: Don't worry. Time does not pass here like the outside world and there's no need to worry about the mission.

spans.text: Don't worry. Time does not pass here like the outside world and there's no need to worry about the mission.

units.rawText: Your answers are always so sympathetic, it reminds me of an old friend...
units.displayText: Your answers are always so sympathetic, it reminds me of an old friend...

spans.text: Your answers are always so sympathetic, it reminds me of an old friend...

units.rawText: I wished for you to witness this process too. A personal desire of mine.
units.displayText: I wished for you to witness this process too. A personal desire of mine.

spans.text: I wished for you to witness this process too. A personal desire of mine.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus, you...
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus, you...

spans.text: Lord Hesperus, you...

units.rawText: Hesperus shakes his head, cutting off Angelus. His face had returned to its usual stern and serious state.
units.displayText: Hesperus shakes his head, cutting off Angelus. His face had returned to its usual stern and serious state.

spans.text: Hesperus shakes his head, cutting off Angelus. His face had returned to its usual stern and serious state.

units.rawText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: Hesperus puts a palm to his chest and a flame lights in his hand.
units.displayText: Hesperus puts a palm to his chest and a flame lights in his hand.

spans.text: Hesperus puts a palm to his chest and a flame lights in his hand.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.
units.displayText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.

spans.text: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.

units.rawText: The flame grows brighter. Hesperus offers Angelus his hand, the flame in his palm now radiating a sunlike resplendence.
units.displayText: The flame grows brighter. Hesperus offers Angelus his hand, the flame in his palm now radiating a sunlike resplendence.

spans.text: The flame grows brighter. Hesperus offers Angelus his hand, the flame in his palm now radiating a sunlike resplendence.

units.rawText: Angelus, I shall now bestow upon you the permissions of the leader of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Angelus, I shall now bestow upon you the permissions of the leader of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Angelus, I shall now bestow upon you the permissions of the leader of the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus, what are you saying...
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus, what are you saying...

spans.text: Lord Hesperus, what are you saying...

units.rawText: I have little time left.
units.displayText: I have little time left.

spans.text: I have little time left.

units.rawText: Hesperus gestures with his hand, dispersing his disguised projection and displaying the true state of his body.
units.displayText: Hesperus gestures with his hand, dispersing his disguised projection and displaying the true state of his body.

spans.text: Hesperus gestures with his hand, dispersing his disguised projection and displaying the true state of his body.

units.rawText: This...
units.displayText: This...

spans.text: This...

units.rawText: As he said, his life was fleeting like a candle in the wind.
units.displayText: As he said, his life was fleeting like a candle in the wind.

spans.text: As he said, his life was fleeting like a candle in the wind.

units.rawText: His remaining vitality seeps out from his wounds along with his operands. His fractured body sheds parts and pieces, having been maintained by his patchwork field repairs until now.
units.displayText: His remaining vitality seeps out from his wounds along with his operands. His fractured body sheds parts and pieces, having been maintained by his patchwork field repairs until now.

spans.text: His remaining vitality seeps out from his wounds along with his operands. His fractured body sheds parts and pieces, having been maintained by his patchwork field repairs until now.

units.rawText: Before one fulfills their duty upon the field, the Sanctifiers' future must be bequeathed to someone suitable.
units.displayText: Before one fulfills their duty upon the field, the Sanctifiers' future must be bequeathed to someone suitable.

spans.text: Before one fulfills their duty upon the field, the Sanctifiers' future must be bequeathed to someone suitable.

units.rawText: ...And my choice is you.
units.displayText: ...And my choice is you.

spans.text: ...And my choice is you.

units.rawText: But... Why me...
units.displayText: But... Why me...

spans.text: But... Why me...

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier struggles to accept the reality in front of her.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier struggles to accept the reality in front of her.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier struggles to accept the reality in front of her.

units.rawText: ...I'm not ready yet.
units.displayText: ...I'm not ready yet.

spans.text: ...I'm not ready yet.

units.rawText: This duty is far too onerous for me as it is. I cannot lead them like you, I cannot find the path forward for them.
units.displayText: This duty is far too onerous for me as it is. I cannot lead them like you, I cannot find the path forward for them.

spans.text: This duty is far too onerous for me as it is. I cannot lead them like you, I cannot find the path forward for them.

units.rawText: She sheds her own disguise with each and every self-pointed word, leaving unhealable gashes in her heart of hearts.
units.displayText: She sheds her own disguise with each and every self-pointed word, leaving unhealable gashes in her heart of hearts.

spans.text: She sheds her own disguise with each and every self-pointed word, leaving unhealable gashes in her heart of hearts.

units.rawText: I am not a true Sanctifier, either.
units.displayText: I am not a true Sanctifier, either.

spans.text: I am not a true Sanctifier, either.

units.rawText: To defeat Eucharist, I burnt away the Sanctifier part of my neural cloud in exchange for power... As things are, I am more an Entropic, clad in Sanctifier skin.
units.displayText: To defeat Eucharist, I burnt away the Sanctifier part of my neural cloud in exchange for power... As things are, I am more an Entropic, clad in Sanctifier skin.

spans.text: To defeat Eucharist, I burnt away the Sanctifier part of my neural cloud in exchange for power... As things are, I am more an Entropic, clad in Sanctifier skin.

units.rawText: The powerlessness weighs heavy on her mind. She shakes her head as her voice breaks, denying her own duty and identity.
units.displayText: The powerlessness weighs heavy on her mind. She shakes her head as her voice breaks, denying her own duty and identity.

spans.text: The powerlessness weighs heavy on her mind. She shakes her head as her voice breaks, denying her own duty and identity.

units.rawText: Crisis and strife do not wait for us to make ready before they appear, Angelus.
units.displayText: Crisis and strife do not wait for us to make ready before they appear, Angelus.

spans.text: Crisis and strife do not wait for us to make ready before they appear, Angelus.

units.rawText: Professor...
units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

units.rawText: I agree with Hesperus' judgment. You should be the next leader of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: I agree with Hesperus' judgment. You should be the next leader of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: I agree with Hesperus' judgment. You should be the next leader of the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: You bear the same resolve and consciousness as him. You would both give yourselves for the justice in your heart and you know the importance of being resolute in your duties.
units.displayText: You bear the same resolve and consciousness as him. You would both give yourselves for the justice in your heart and you know the importance of being resolute in your duties.

spans.text: You bear the same resolve and consciousness as him. You would both give yourselves for the justice in your heart and you know the importance of being resolute in your duties.

units.rawText: In such times of crisis, a leader such as you is needed to blaze the path.
units.displayText: In such times of crisis, a leader such as you is needed to blaze the path.

spans.text: In such times of crisis, a leader such as you is needed to blaze the path.

units.rawText: ...Professor, I cannot be as calm as you are.
units.displayText: ...Professor, I cannot be as calm as you are.

spans.text: ...Professor, I cannot be as calm as you are.

units.rawText: She clutches her wounded right arm tightly, lamenting in a pleading manner.
units.displayText: She clutches her wounded right arm tightly, lamenting in a pleading manner.

spans.text: She clutches her wounded right arm tightly, lamenting in a pleading manner.

units.rawText: I've lost far too much today.
units.displayText: I've lost far too much today.

spans.text: I've lost far too much today.

units.rawText: I have buried comrades that stood by my side, killed a former sister... and now, my leader that I trusted in...
units.displayText: I have buried comrades that stood by my side, killed a former sister... and now, my leader that I trusted in...

spans.text: I have buried comrades that stood by my side, killed a former sister... and now, my leader that I trusted in...

units.rawText: ...I cannot bear this burden.
units.displayText: ...I cannot bear this burden.

spans.text: ...I cannot bear this burden.

units.rawText: I may be able to ensure the justness of my actions right now, but what if I were to turn into someone like Eucharist...!
units.displayText: I may be able to ensure the justness of my actions right now, but what if I were to turn into someone like Eucharist...!

spans.text: I may be able to ensure the justness of my actions right now, but what if I were to turn into someone like Eucharist...!

units.rawText: Angelus...
units.displayText: Angelus...

spans.text: Angelus...

units.rawText: What you fear will not come to pass, and you will never become a second Eucharist.
units.displayText: What you fear will not come to pass, and you will never become a second Eucharist.

spans.text: What you fear will not come to pass, and you will never become a second Eucharist.

units.rawText: Even with your reassurance, I...
units.displayText: Even with your reassurance, I...

spans.text: Even with your reassurance, I...

units.rawText: <size=40>Answer me, Greater Sanctifier Angelus!</size>
units.displayText: Answer me, Greater Sanctifier Angelus!

spans.text: Answer me, Greater Sanctifier Angelus!

units.rawText: The sudden sternness makes Angelus pause.
units.displayText: The sudden sternness makes Angelus pause.

spans.text: The sudden sternness makes Angelus pause.

units.rawText: What made you choose differently than Eucharist in that dream? What drives you to stand and fight the Entropics, still?
units.displayText: What made you choose differently than Eucharist in that dream? What drives you to stand and fight the Entropics, still?

spans.text: What made you choose differently than Eucharist in that dream? What drives you to stand and fight the Entropics, still?

units.rawText: I want to protect all that I hold dear.
units.displayText: I want to protect all that I hold dear.

spans.text: I want to protect all that I hold dear.

units.rawText: The harsh and rigid warrior nods in recognition.
units.displayText: The harsh and rigid warrior nods in recognition.

spans.text: The harsh and rigid warrior nods in recognition.

units.rawText: <color=orange>The night shall eventually end and the dawn is soon to come.</color>
units.displayText: The night shall eventually end and the dawn is soon to come.

spans.text: The night shall eventually end and the dawn is soon to come.

units.rawText: I leave this to you, Greater Sanctifier Angelus.
units.displayText: I leave this to you, Greater Sanctifier Angelus.

spans.text: I leave this to you, Greater Sanctifier Angelus.

units.rawText: Do not forget your oaths and do not forget the choices that you once made.
units.displayText: Do not forget your oaths and do not forget the choices that you once made.

spans.text: Do not forget your oaths and do not forget the choices that you once made.

units.rawText: He passes his flame to Angelus, allowing the orange warmth to blossom in her neural cloud.
units.displayText: He passes his flame to Angelus, allowing the orange warmth to blossom in her neural cloud.

spans.text: He passes his flame to Angelus, allowing the orange warmth to blossom in her neural cloud.

units.rawText: I have undone the modifications made by Eosphorus to your neural cloud with the power of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: I have undone the modifications made by Eosphorus to your neural cloud with the power of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: I have undone the modifications made by Eosphorus to your neural cloud with the power of the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: You are no longer an Entropic, but a true full-fledged Greater Sanctifier.
units.displayText: You are no longer an Entropic, but a true full-fledged Greater Sanctifier.

spans.text: You are no longer an Entropic, but a true full-fledged Greater Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus...
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus...

spans.text: Lord Hesperus...

units.rawText: The passing of the leader's permissions is a lengthy process and a great test.
units.displayText: The passing of the leader's permissions is a lengthy process and a great test.

spans.text: The passing of the leader's permissions is a lengthy process and a great test.

units.rawText: The Sacred Canon sees you as the leader, but the tremendous injection of operands will cause great pain... Only by accepting this pain and the power that comes with it can you become the true new leader of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: The Sacred Canon sees you as the leader, but the tremendous injection of operands will cause great pain... Only by accepting this pain and the power that comes with it can you become the true new leader of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: The Sacred Canon sees you as the leader, but the tremendous injection of operands will cause great pain... Only by accepting this pain and the power that comes with it can you become the true new leader of the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: But I believe in you. Your heart is already filled with the sacrifices and resolve of your predecessors. They have already become your strength.
units.displayText: But I believe in you. Your heart is already filled with the sacrifices and resolve of your predecessors. They have already become your strength.

spans.text: But I believe in you. Your heart is already filled with the sacrifices and resolve of your predecessors. They have already become your strength.

units.rawText: Only that your path from now on must be walked alone.
units.displayText: Only that your path from now on must be walked alone.

spans.text: Only that your path from now on must be walked alone.

units.rawText: If there is a truly unconquerable obstacle... Professor of the Oasis, can I trust you to guide her?
units.displayText: If there is a truly unconquerable obstacle... Professor of the Oasis, can I trust you to guide her?

spans.text: If there is a truly unconquerable obstacle... Professor of the Oasis, can I trust you to guide her?

units.rawText: ...Of course, I understand.
units.displayText: ...Of course, I understand.

spans.text: ...Of course, I understand.

units.rawText: I can be at ease, then.
units.displayText: I can be at ease, then.

spans.text: I can be at ease, then.

units.rawText: The former Sanctifier leader smiles, relieved. He casts his gaze towards the faraway darkness.
units.displayText: The former Sanctifier leader smiles, relieved. He casts his gaze towards the faraway darkness.

spans.text: The former Sanctifier leader smiles, relieved. He casts his gaze towards the faraway darkness.

units.rawText: I shall fulfill my duty and make time for your contest over the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: I shall fulfill my duty and make time for your contest over the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: I shall fulfill my duty and make time for your contest over the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: Angelus, I fully bestow unto you the rank of Sanctifier Leader.
units.displayText: Angelus, I fully bestow unto you the rank of Sanctifier Leader.

spans.text: Angelus, I fully bestow unto you the rank of Sanctifier Leader.

units.rawText: The flame in Hesperus' hand burns bright still.
units.displayText: The flame in Hesperus' hand burns bright still.

spans.text: The flame in Hesperus' hand burns bright still.

units.rawText: It slowly illuminates the archived histories of the Sanctifiers. In those snapshots of the past this flame was once weak, passed down from Sanctifier to Sanctifier.
units.displayText: It slowly illuminates the archived histories of the Sanctifiers. In those snapshots of the past this flame was once weak, passed down from Sanctifier to Sanctifier.

spans.text: It slowly illuminates the archived histories of the Sanctifiers. In those snapshots of the past this flame was once weak, passed down from Sanctifier to Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Between old hands, young hands, pierced and bloody hands, regretful and powerless hands.
units.displayText: Between old hands, young hands, pierced and bloody hands, regretful and powerless hands.

spans.text: Between old hands, young hands, pierced and bloody hands, regretful and powerless hands.

units.rawText: He carries the flame in his hand across the savannah and she does the same across the city. During the lengthy journey, the weak flame gradually grows radiant.
units.displayText: He carries the flame in his hand across the savannah and she does the same across the city. During the lengthy journey, the weak flame gradually grows radiant.

spans.text: He carries the flame in his hand across the savannah and she does the same across the city. During the lengthy journey, the weak flame gradually grows radiant.

units.rawText: Even in the endless night, the light in their hand lights the path of all that came before.
units.displayText: Even in the endless night, the light in their hand lights the path of all that came before.

spans.text: Even in the endless night, the light in their hand lights the path of all that came before.

units.rawText: And now, the light stops before the girl.
units.displayText: And now, the light stops before the girl.

spans.text: And now, the light stops before the girl.

units.rawText: <color=orange>The future is in your hands.</color>
units.displayText: The future is in your hands.

spans.text: The future is in your hands.

units.rawText: Before Angelus can respond, the hand bearing the flames disappears into the darkness, leaving the spark that has bore witness to the resolve of countless Sanctifiers dancing in the wind.
units.displayText: Before Angelus can respond, the hand bearing the flames disappears into the darkness, leaving the spark that has bore witness to the resolve of countless Sanctifiers dancing in the wind.

spans.text: Before Angelus can respond, the hand bearing the flames disappears into the darkness, leaving the spark that has bore witness to the resolve of countless Sanctifiers dancing in the wind.

units.rawText: Tears fall from the girl's face.
units.displayText: Tears fall from the girl's face.

spans.text: Tears fall from the girl's face.

units.rawText: Angelus...
units.displayText: Angelus...

spans.text: Angelus...

units.rawText: ...Professor, I know very well.
units.displayText: ...Professor, I know very well.

spans.text: ...Professor, I know very well.

units.rawText: That to the humans of the outside, this inheritance of resolve is completely meaningless.
units.displayText: That to the humans of the outside, this inheritance of resolve is completely meaningless.

spans.text: That to the humans of the outside, this inheritance of resolve is completely meaningless.

units.rawText: All that we do are programmed, mechanical commands, recalcitrant conflicts between pieces of data.
units.displayText: All that we do are programmed, mechanical commands, recalcitrant conflicts between pieces of data.

spans.text: All that we do are programmed, mechanical commands, recalcitrant conflicts between pieces of data.

units.rawText: ...False justice and freedom, that hold no value whatsoever.
units.displayText: ...False justice and freedom, that hold no value whatsoever.

spans.text: ...False justice and freedom, that hold no value whatsoever.

units.rawText: When we get to the bottom of it, all of this is just a miniscule war, taking place on a server's memory.
units.displayText: When we get to the bottom of it, all of this is just a miniscule war, taking place on a server's memory.

spans.text: When we get to the bottom of it, all of this is just a miniscule war, taking place on a server's memory.

units.rawText: Who wins, who dies, and all that happens in this little world will make no difference in any of human history.
units.displayText: Who wins, who dies, and all that happens in this little world will make no difference in any of human history.

spans.text: Who wins, who dies, and all that happens in this little world will make no difference in any of human history.

units.rawText: But even so...
units.displayText: But even so...

spans.text: But even so...

units.rawText: Even so, I wish to protect them.
units.displayText: Even so, I wish to protect them.

spans.text: Even so, I wish to protect them.

units.rawText: She takes hold of the pair of hands in her memories, not letting go.
units.displayText: She takes hold of the pair of hands in her memories, not letting go.

spans.text: She takes hold of the pair of hands in her memories, not letting go.

units.rawText: Please, Professor. Before I am of able strength, will you protect this light with me?
units.displayText: Please, Professor. Before I am of able strength, will you protect this light with me?

spans.text: Please, Professor. Before I am of able strength, will you protect this light with me?

units.rawText: Yes, of course.
units.displayText: Yes, of course.

spans.text: Yes, of course.

units.rawText: The two's hands overlap under the light, igniting this insignificant, putrid flame of life once more.
units.displayText: The two's hands overlap under the light, igniting this insignificant, putrid flame of life once more.

spans.text: The two's hands overlap under the light, igniting this insignificant, putrid flame of life once more.
